name: JWT: kid traversal -> forged claims -> object access
goal: Break token integrity (empty-key signing, claim forgery) and ride the forged identity into object-level access.
preconditions: JWT in Authorization header or cookie; a kid parameter and role claims present.
impact: Attacker-signed tokens accepted as any user/role; horizontal and vertical privilege escalation.

steps.purpose: Prove verification weakness: kid-controlled key lookup accepting an attacker-chosen (empty) key.
steps.on_success: Sign tokens as anyone; jump straight to step 3 if role claims are attacker-writable.
steps.on_fail: kid rejected -> try alg:none, RS256->HS256 confusion (public key from /jwks), jku/x5u injection (documented variants).

steps.purpose: Prove the verifier accepts re-signed claims (role/user/sub) — the escalation primitive.
steps.on_fail: Claims verified against server state -> fall back to session-layer chains (cross-origin-action-suite).

steps.purpose: Use the forged identity to enumerate other tenants' objects.
steps.on_fail: Object authz intact server-side -> document token forgery alone (still critical).

recon.name: Token census
recon.how: Collect every token shape the app issues (login, refresh, email confirm) and diff their claims and algorithms.
recon.signal: Different verification per token type; weaker one is the way in.

recon.name: Header param sweep
recon.how: Test kid path traversal, jku/x5u remote JWKS, and duplicate JSON keys in the header.
recon.signal: Verifier behavior changes with header content.

recon.name: JWKS endpoint probe
recon.how: Find /jwks /keys /.well-known/jwks.json; public keys enable HS256 confusion attempts.
recon.signal: RS256->HS256 confusion accepts when key cache misbehaves.

recon.name: Expiry/audience laxness
recon.how: Replay expired tokens, swap aud/iss across services, drop exp entirely.
recon.signal: Verifier checks signature but not context.

recon.name: Cookie scope pairing
recon.how: Pair JWT cookies with web/Cookie Domain scope overbreadth — a forged cookie on any subdomain lands on the app.

pivot_hints: forged admin -> BFLA chain for function-level proof
pair with oauth chain when login is OAuth-backed
